title: the_landlord_who_paid_me
display_title: My landlord started paying ME rent, and he won't say why.
beats: My landlord (61M) transferred me $900 last night with the memo 'rent' -- I don't owe him anything, he owes ME an explanation.
I texted asking if it was a mistake. He replied: 'No mistake. Same time next month too.'
I've lived in this basement unit for two years. Never once has he been early, let alone paying me.
I checked my lease for the tenth time -- and noticed the unit number listed isn't mine. It's the one directly above me. Empty since the guy who lived there vanished last spring.
I asked my landlord who used to live up there. He left me on read for six hours, then sent one line: 'Stop asking and keep the money.'
I haven't cashed it. It's just sitting in my account, growing by $900 every month. What is he paying me to forget?
